prebuildChecks.pattern: Each prebuild check has INLINE bash functions (_update_cpu, _update_gpu, _update_memory) that write hardware-config directly
prebuildChecks.why: update-hardware-config script only exists AFTER nixos-rebuild switch. Prebuild runs BEFORE the build.

passwordManagement.why: More reliable than passwd + grep /etc/shadow pattern

backupSystem.backupBeforeDelete: system-config.nix backed up before deletion during migration

platformNotes.nixEval: nix-instantiate for eval; nix eval also available

commonErrors.cause: External cmd called in prebuild check

commonErrors.symptom: jq: error: formatValue/0 is not defined
commonErrors.cause: jq function called via pipe instead of direct arg
